property.description: Overlapping IP fragmentation : difference in offset of concomitant fragments less than fragment length (allowed but could be an evasion).

event.description: Later fragment of the same datagram that starts inside the data of the first one
event.boolean_expression: ((ip.identification == ip.identification.1)&&((ip.frag_offset > ip.frag_offset.1)&&((((ip.frag_offset - ip.frag_offset.1) + ip.header_len.1) < ip.tot_len.1)&&((ip.src == ip.src.1)&&(ip.dst == ip.dst.1)))))
